card.name: Linking words after a noun phrase
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as and, which, it, or an opening parenthesis that come right after a noun and start an added clause or aside. Seen in general prose and in the serotonin-drug interaction sentence.

modes.label: Conjunction after a name or noun
modes.description: The word 'and' joins two names or nouns, such as a couple's names or paired nouns like fortunes and destiny.
modes.example: This material was prepared for Religion Online by Ted<< and>> Winnie Brock.

modes.label: Parenthesis after serotonin
modes.description: An opening bracket after 'serotonin' begins a clarifying aside about MAOIs.
modes.example: and with drugs that impair metabolism of serotonin<< (>>in particular, MAOIs, both

modes.label: Relative word after a noun
modes.description: Words such as which, have, or it follow a noun and introduce a clause that describes it.
modes.example: have resulted in barbarous acts<< which>> have outraged the conscience of mankind”.

card.writes: No clear meaning; it weakly promotes Chinese and miscellaneous tokens, so the output effect is unclear.
card.plain: It fires on small joining words or a bracket right after a noun, where the sentence adds more detail.
